tenBlocks.block3_goal: An eight-shot, thirty-second segment inside a multi-part animated family story establishing ordinary living room and escalating Yugioh battles with scientist warmth break. It ends the instant @Shaz sits tall in the warm proud hold — do not continue beyond that moment, do not resolve anything, do not add an ending. The comedy is played completely straight. Nobody in frame knows anything is funny.
tenBlocks.block4_continuity: Location: the room in @family_living_room, afternoon, throughout. Never leave it. The camera stays on the same side of the action as in @family_living_room for the whole segment and never crosses to the other side. @Shaz center on carpet, @Brother left, @Sister right, 180-degree axis locked and this never flips. Only two on screen per shot, no background crowd, no face repeats. Costume is fixed for the whole segment and never changes. @Mom wears deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair and no dark band, @Sister wears warm mustard hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair and no dark band, and this never changes.
tenBlocks.block6_visualStyle: Feature-quality 3D animated film, production CG, not photorealistic and not flat cartoon. Warm afternoon daylight with soft subsurface glow through ears and skin, tactile materials for carpet, cotton, cards and skin. Depth of field as a natural in-camera optical artifact keeping foreground subject crisp. Clean straight-played family comedy staging.
tenBlocks.block7_cameraAndPerformance: This is an eight-shot segment with seven cuts between shots, every shot ending in a hard cut, total thirty seconds. The body plays broad. The face stays honest. No mugging, no pulled faces, no comic reactions. Anticipation: movement winds the opposite way first. Snap and Settle: fast transition between poses with overshoot on arrival. Moving Holds: held poses breathe and micro-shift, never frozen mannequins. Overlap and Secondary Action: hair, cloth and attachments arrive a beat late. Eye Life: micro-saccades, catchlights and blink rate, eyes never glaze over.
tenBlocks.block8_audio: Foley: carpet shuffle, cards shuffling and handling, soft knee bounce, gentle claps. Ambient room tone: quiet family living room atmosphere with faint distant television murmur and soft breathing. Score: subtle pizzicato strings with light comedic timing accents, warm swell on proud moment, then quiet.
tenBlocks.block9_exclusions: The only spoken words in the entire segment are the lines in braces. Nothing else written anywhere in this prompt is dialogue, and nobody speaks who is not named on a line. No extra cuts anywhere. No unison movement. No subtitles, no watermark, no logo.
